boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named study environments in Mullen Library, spanning silent reading rooms, group-study rooms, reference materials, and computer access.

cards.title: Reference Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 125, first floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Set up here when you need a silent-study setting and want general, social-sciences, or humanities reference works close by.
cards.short_summary: A silent room paired with reference encyclopedias, handbooks, and almanacs.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen’s first-floor Reference Reading Room is designated silent study and houses general, social-sciences, and humanities reference collections.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Room 125 on Mullen Library’s first-floor directory; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Adele R. Chwalek Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 127, first floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or research materials and use the room’s tables and comfortable chairs for a longer seated work session.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor reading room furnished with study tables and comfortable chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Adele R. Chwalek Reading Room on Mullen’s first floor has several tables and comfortable chairs for studying and research.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Room 127 and group-study space on Mullen Library’s first-floor directory; visitors may use study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Mullen Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Room 116, first floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Choose this stop when your work requires a desktop; the library identifies the first-floor lobby and Computer Lab as its main public-computer locations.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lab for computer-based coursework and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Most public-use computers in Mullen Library are located on the first floor, in the lobby and the Computer Lab.
cards.access_notes: The first-floor directory identifies the Computer Lab as Room 116. Library computer and printing policies may require a Catholic University network login.

cards.title: Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 215, second floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Use this group-study room when your research benefits from browsing current newspapers, magazines, print indexes, or bibliographies between tasks.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor group space with current periodicals and print research tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Reading Room on Mullen’s second floor contains current newspapers, magazines, print indexes, bibliographies, and group-study space.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Room 215 and designated for group study on the Mullen Library directory; visitors may use study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Stacks Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 222, second floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Meet collaborators here for a shared work block; the library specifically names this room as one of its second-floor group-study locations.
cards.short_summary: A designated second-floor room for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library states that groups may study together in the Stacks Reading Room, Room 222.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Room 222 and group-study space; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Corner Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 216, second floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Bring a small group and use this named room for discussion-based study; check the second-floor directory when navigating from the stacks.
cards.short_summary: A separate second-floor room expressly available for groups studying together.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library says groups may study together in the Corner Reading Room, Room 216.
cards.access_notes: Listed as Room 216 and group-study space; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Religious Studies/Philosophy Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 314, third floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Head to this third-floor silent-study reading room when you want a designated quiet environment alongside the religious studies and philosophy collection.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor silent-study room near religious studies and philosophy materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library’s third-floor directory identifies Room 314 as the Religious Studies/Philosophy Reading Room and labels it silent study.
cards.source_title: Third Floor — Mullen Library Interactive Map
cards.access_notes: The third floor is reserved for silent study unless otherwise posted; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Greek and Latin Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 316, third floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Use this silent-study room for focused reading, particularly when you need the nearby Greek and Latin research collection on the third floor.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor silent-study room associated with Greek and Latin materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library’s third-floor directory identifies Room 316 as the Greek and Latin Reading Room and labels it silent study.
cards.source_title: Third Floor — Mullen Library Interactive Map
cards.access_notes: The third floor is reserved for silent study unless otherwise posted; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Seminar Room
cards.subtitle: Room 317, third floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Plan a quiet individual work session in this named third-floor room, then confirm on arrival whether a class or library use has the room occupied.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor silent-study room with a room-specific map listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library’s third-floor directory identifies Room 317 as the Seminar Room and labels it silent study.
cards.access_notes: The third floor is reserved for silent study unless otherwise posted; the library’s page does not state a reservation policy for this room.

cards.title: Third-Floor Silent Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Room 301, third floor, Mullen Library
cards.notes: Use the room-301 hall for quiet solo work after choosing a seat; keep conversations elsewhere because the library marks this corridor for silent study.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed third-floor hall designated for silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen Library’s third-floor directory identifies Room 301 as a Hall designated for silent study.
cards.source_title: Third Floor — Mullen Library Interactive Map
cards.access_notes: The third floor is reserved for silent study unless otherwise posted; visitors may use Mullen study spaces first-come, first-served.
